title: Dreamt I was in a clean, recently abandoned mall
content: I usually dream in 3rd person, and in this dream I was watching someone watching me in this mall. I was (presumably) the only living soul in the place, I wandered from place to place and stopped by the empty food court to find something to eat. Once I got to an area near a water fountain, shuffling noises were heard. It then ended with zombies or some kind of undead monsters appearing from behind, and it promptly ends there.
